profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at MIB Group, Inc.
profile.summary: IT professional with over 16 years of experience, highly focused on performance and self-development; always enthusiastic, open to challenges and eager to learn new technologies.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Define and document architecture solutions
- Lead the development team to analyze, design, implement, maintain and document Spring (Java) and cloud-native applications in accordance with MIB’s standards
- Ensure that the development team delivers high-quality products in a timely manner
- Lead the development team to migrate applications to AWS Cloud
- Lead the IT organization to adopt and implement architecture best practices
- Contribute to project planning and effort estimates
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Agile Methodologies and +9 skills

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Analyze, design, implement, maintain and document software components in accordance with MIB’s standards, software architecture and software development processes

positions.title: Full Stack Developer / Technical Lead
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Consultant at Deloitte LLP for the state of New Hampshire
- Lead the development team to analyze, design, implement and maintain the Java backend supporting https://nheasy.nh.gov/, a self-service Web portal used by New Hampshire citizens to manage their social benefits
- End to end analysis, design and implementation of a JavaScript-based live chat application to provide support to customers of the Web portal
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Spring Framework and +6 skills

company.name: HSBC México – Retail Banking and Wealth Management

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Member of the architecture board that oversights the implementation and governance of software development projects following a TOGAF-based methodology
- Analysis and design of solutions for electronic channels, such as Mobile Banking, Internet Banking, Phone Banking and Contact Center
- Subject matter expert in Web technologies, coding standards, best practices and electronic channels
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Spring Framework and +6 skills

positions.title: Sr. Systems Analyst / Technical Lead / Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- High level design of the enterprise integration solutions that support Mobile Banking
- Low level design specification of the Java components supporting Mobile Banking
- Analysis, design and implementation of an authentication subsystem for Mobile Banking using technologies like Soft Token, Vasco VACMAN Controller and nCipher HSM
- High level design of the integration between Mobile and Internet Banking
- Lead implementation of agile methodologies and Rational Team Concert
- Contribute to the “Front End Development Handbook”, a compilation of best practices for Java developers
- Subject matter expert in data encryption
- Analysis, design and implementation of a .NET application to manage offers and sales performed by the Call Center
- Implementation of a Proof of Concept for Mobile Banking based on the integration between HSBC core banking services and a Gemalto (now Thales) mobile application
- Analysis, design and implementation of an HSM Encoder, a Java API to simplify and standardize the use of nCipher HSM across HSBC Mexico
- Analysis, design and implementation of a centralized JEE service used by several applications to notify customers via SMS
- Maintenance of public Web sites moving components from a Struts-based framework into a Spring-based framework
- Requirements gathering for insurance management systems
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Spring Framework and +4 skills

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Analysis, design, implementation and maintenance of a student management system for a
vocational technical high school using technologies like Java, Apache Struts and Oracle
